title: A query measure can count the rows of a query table built with a measure filter

source.supports: the page gives this example: a query table of the products with no orders and a measure counting its rows

derivation: In FILTER the measure has a context transition per product: Bike 3 rows, Helmet 2, Lock 2, Scooter none (BLANK). BLANK + 0 = 0, so only Scooter is kept. COUNTROWS ( Unsold ) = 1.
